title: Container Report - Week 43
summary:
Container
Container freight markets were a mixed picture over the past week, with the FBX Weighted Average decreasing from 3,577 at the start of the week to 3,513 by the end of the week. The most notable movement was seen on the Asia to US East Coast trade, where rates dropped from $10,754 to $9,927/FEU over the week. This drop accounted for most of the decrease in the composite index.
